data.gender_notes: Mustapha is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: My lord has chosen, preferred, loved and annointed. Derived from the trilateral Arabic root 's-t-f', which signifies to choose, to prefer, to elect. In the Quran, Prophet Musa (Moses) is called 'Khaṭṭāb al-Mustafa', meaning 'the Chosen One'. The name Mustapha carries the meaning “Chosen one, elect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mustapha usually hope their child will grow to embody chosen one, elect and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mustapha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chosen one, elect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustapha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
